n=len(target)
stack=[]; pairs={}
for i,ch in enumerate(target):
    if ch=='(': stack.append(i)
    elif ch==')':
        j=stack.pop(); pairs[j]=i; pairs[i]=j
unpaired=[i for i in range(n) if i not in pairs]
# unit sequences
u0 = "CGUUCCCCAAGUUCACGCAAGGCCGAAAGGAAAACCAAGCACGCGGUUCAGGUUCG"
u1 = "CCGUACAAUUGAUAGGGGGAGCAUCAGGAAGTCCGCAGCCAGAACCGUUCGUUAGG"
u2 = "GGGGUACC"
u3 = u0
u4 = u1
units = [(5,u0),(75,u1),(139,u2),(147,u3),(217,u4)]
def build(muts):
    seq=['A']*n
    filled=[False]*n
    for start,u in units:
        for k,c in enumerate(u):
            seq[start+k]=c; filled[start+k]=True
    for i in range(n):
        if not filled[i]:
            if i in pairs and i<pairs[i] and not filled[pairs[i]]:
                seq[i]='G'; seq[pairs[i]]='C'; filled[i]=True; filled[pairs[i]]=True
    for pos,b in muts.items():
        seq[pos]=b
    return ''.join(seq)
def score(s):
    fc=RNA.fold_compound(s)
    ss,mfe=fc.mfe()
    return RNA.bp_distance(ss,target), ss

best_d=cur_d

t0=time.time()
it=0
while time.time()-t0<170 and best_d>0:
    it+=1
    # mutate a random unpaired position to a random base
    pos=random.choice(unpaired)
    b=random.choice('ACGU')
    nmuts=dict(best_muts); nmuts[pos]=b
    d,ss=score(build(nmuts))

        cur_d=d; cur_ss=ss; best_muts=nmuts
        if d<best_d:
            best_d=d
            print("improve",best_d,"at",it)
s=build(best_muts)
print("BEST",best_d)
print("SEQ",s)
